                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qq21497936/p/21703594" title="发布于 2026-07-20 20:29">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">海康工业相机开发笔记（一）：MVS软件基本介绍、搭建SDK基础环境</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  海康的工业相机SDK开发。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="MVS_5"></a>MVS软件</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  海康机器人官方工业相机配套上位机软件MVS，用于海康全系列工业相机的设备发现、图像采集、参数调试、图像保存，是机器视觉项目调试标准工具。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858295-481500389.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_9"></a>左侧设备树栏</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>GigE：千兆网口工业相机适配网卡列表，包含物理网卡、虚拟机虚拟网卡、无线网卡 WLAN；</li>
<li>USB：USB3.0/USB XHC 工业相机控制器通道；</li>
<li>Camera Link、GenTL：兼容第三方工业相机通用协议通道；</li>
<li>当前状态提示「无设备信息」：代表电脑未接入任何海康工业相机，未识别到采集设备。</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_14"></a>主视觉展示区</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  背景为海康全产品线硬件阵列，覆盖完整机器视觉硬件生态：</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>底层：微型小靶面工业相机、紧凑型面阵相机；</li>
<li>中层：大靶面高分辨率面阵相机（CS 系列主流机型，黑白 / 彩色、全局 / 卷帘快门全覆盖）；</li>
<li>上层：视觉光源控制器（恒流调光电源，配套视觉打光系统）；</li>
<li>右下角：PCIe 图像采集卡，适配 Camera Link、CoaXPress 等高速接口相机。</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_20"></a>硬件产品</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="CS__21"></a>CS 系列面阵工业相机（核心产品）</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>像素覆盖：160万～1.5亿超高分辨率；</li>
<li>接口类型：GigE、USB3.0、CoaXPress；</li>
<li>快门类型：全局快门（高速运动物体无拖影）、卷帘快门（静态检测高性价比）；</li>
<li>应用：尺寸测量、缺陷检测、外观分拣、3D 视觉、半导体检测。</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_26"></a>光源控制器</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  多通道数字调光电源，支持频闪、亮度分级调节，配合环形 / 条形 / 同轴光源完成工件打光。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="PCIe_28"></a>PCIe高速采集卡</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  针对超大靶面、超高帧率相机，提供独立带宽，解决千兆网带宽瓶颈。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_30"></a>虚拟相机</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  MVS软件提供了虚拟相机的软件，这个方便软件的同时也同样方便我们调试sdk。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858293-42376711.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  添加一个usb相机和gige相机：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858312-1690957224.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="SDKQtDemo_40"></a>提取SDK搭建Qt基础模板Demo</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="sdk_41"></a>步骤一：确认带了开发sdk</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  下载mvs软件的时候，是否包含了开发sdk需要确认（下载好像会有说明），或者安装好后看，安装好包含sdk如下：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858287-852624153.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858281-1783086476.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="Qt_47"></a>步骤二：新建Qt工程</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  Qt5.15.2，msvc2019x64版本。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858305-1569736753.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858292-2073555368.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="sdk_53"></a>步骤三：部署sdk</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858296-1696969291.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202607/1971530-20260720202858278-175088897.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  模块引入sdk：</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp">INCLUDEPATH <span class="token operator">+= $$PWD

    $$PWD<span class="token operator">/HikvisionICamManager<span class="token punctuation">.h

                <span class="token keyword">break<span class="token punctuation">;
            <span class="token keyword">case MV_GENTL_CXP_DEVICE<span class="token operator">:                                       <span class="token comment">// CoaXPress设备
                LOG <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; index <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"type is" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"MV_GENTL_CXP_DEVICE" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"CoaXPress设备"<span class="token punctuation">;

            <span class="token keyword">case MV_GENTL_XOF_DEVICE<span class="token operator">:                                       <span class="token comment">// XoF设备
                LOG <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; index <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"type is" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"MV_GENTL_XOF_DEVICE" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"XoF设备"<span class="token punctuation">;
                <span class="token keyword">break<span class="token punctuation">;
            <span class="token keyword">default<span class="token operator">:                                                        <span class="token comment">// 未知设备类型，保留意义
                LOG <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; index <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"type is" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"MV_UNKNOW_DEVICE" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"未知设备类型，保留意义"<span class="token punctuation">;
                <span class="token keyword">break<span class="token punctuation">;
            <span class="token punctuation">}
        <span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token comment">// 步骤四: 释放SDK资源: 调用 MV_CC_Finalize()释放SDK资源。
    <span class="token function">MV_CC_Finalize<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    LOG<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></spa
